movement_profile.footwork: Fast footwork combined with rhythmic swaying

signature_moves.description: Rhythmic movement of the shoulders to the drum beat
signature_moves.name: Shoulder undulations

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Varies between fast (Chaud) and slow/heavy (Grand Coup)

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Nago Chaud (fast) and Nago Grand Coup (slow/heavy)
music_profile.sound_description: The music is driven by the polyrhythmic interplay of three Rada cowhide-head drums, alternating between fast, driving beats and slow, heavy, percussive pulses.
music_profile.vocal_style: Ritual singing, including the 'Haut Chant Nago'

teaching.level_notes: Requires high physical stamina and coordination due to the muscular nature of the movements.
teaching.rhythm: Nago Chaud (fast) or Nago Grand Coup (slow/heavy)
